instruction: Remove all the songs that I have liked from my Spotify queue, and then start the player.
notes: The queue is modeled as a hypothetical snapshot with three songs: two liked (to be removed) and one not liked (must stay); scale the song/position/count objects and the next-liked-to-remove facts to the real queue at runtime. Both spotify.show_song_queue and spotify.show_liked_songs are required before any removal (the agent must intersect queue song ids with liked song ids). Because remove_song_from_queue takes a position and removing an entry shifts later positions, removals are forced in descending position order via a discrete count chain: (liked-in-queue ?c) counts liked songs still queued, (next-liked-to-remove ?c ?s) names the highest-positioned remaining liked song, and (count-after-removal ?c ?c2) decrements; count-0 is a domain constant so supervisor-complete-task can require (liked-in-queue count-0), which is only reachable after every liked song is removed. The non-liked song can never be removed (no next-liked-to-remove fact), matching the evaluation's expected queue. 'and then start the player' is enforced by requiring (not (playing)) for removals, so play_music (no arguments, plays current queue song) must come after all removals; the player is assumed not playing initially. No answer is needed, so complete_task takes no parameters.
